_about: Career layout. Stages in order (easiest first), bosses are the cars you win there (weakest cars first, strongest last), menace cars race on their classic stages for character. Edited by hand; names must match the game's stage and car names.

tours.title: Welcome to the Madness
tours.blurb: Learn to race. Learn to waste. This is the easy part.

stages.name: Introductory Stage
stages.coach: Two checkpoints, three laps, one fixing hoop. Welcome to the madness, rookie.

stages.name: Let the Dream Begin
stages.coach: Ramps everywhere. Land on your wheels and the power keeps coming.

stages.name: Contrary To Popular Belief
stages.coach: Contrary to popular belief, sand is not your friend. Stay on the road.

stages.name: Grapefruit Power
stages.coach: One lap. Flat out. Blink and it's over.

stages.name: Arrested by the Man
stages.coach: The law is out tonight, and it hits hard. Don't let it catch you on the hairpins.

stages.name: Dragrace Of Death
stages.coach: A drag race. With death in the name. What could go wrong?

stages.name: Do The Snake Dance
stages.coach: Zig, zag, crunch. Learn the snake dance and they'll never hit you square.

stages.name: The Stretch
stages.coach: One very long lap. Keep your power up and roll right on the big jump.

stages.name: The Fast & The Furious + The Radical
stages.coach: The Radical One is here, and it only knows one speed.

stages.name: Twisted Revenge
stages.coach: Ten laps? Forget the laps. Revenge is sweeter. Waste them all.

tours.title: The King's Road
tours.blurb: Big air, tight corners, and something very large in your mirror.

stages.name: Paninaro, Caninaro, Let's fly!
stages.coach: EL KING drives this one backwards, looking for you. Fly over him.

stages.name: The 45 Degree Gun Run
stages.coach: The Gun Run, tilted. Point your nose down the barrel and go.

stages.name: Centrifugal Rush, Under Water?
stages.coach: Crossing roads, sharp turns and a hoop in the corner. Is this under water? Nobody knows.

stages.name: He Is Coming For You Next
stages.coach: He is coming for you next. Yes, him. Fix up, then hit first.

stages.name: Ghosts and Magic
stages.coach: Fall behind and the leaders vanish like ghosts. Don't fall behind.

stages.name: The Freeway
stages.coach: Five long laps of open road. Pure speed, nowhere to hide.

stages.name: Maximum Overfly
stages.coach: Giant ramps, and the King wants revenge. Stay airborne, stay alive.

stages.name: Majestic Duty
stages.coach: It's good to be the King. Tonight, be better than him.

stages.name: The Stamina Run
stages.coach: The ramps here give you nothing. Save your power, it has to last.

stages.name: Skid
stages.coach: Nobody finishes Skid. Somebody just survives it.

tours.title: Monsters & Machines
tours.blurb: M A S H E E N, DR Monstaa and their friends would like a word.

stages.name: Rolling with the Big Boys
menace: M A S H E E N
stages.coach: Everyone reverses at the start. You'll see why.

stages.name: When In Danger Just Chill Out
stages.coach: Walls on both sides and danger everywhere. Just chill out. Then hit back.

stages.name: Suddenly the King becomes Santa's Little Helper
menace: M A S H E E N
stages.coach: M A S H E E N and EL KING are working together now. Hell is waiting.

stages.name: Catch the Rabbit
stages.coach: Twelve checkpoints in the dark. Somebody out there is the rabbit. Catch it.

stages.name: Digger's Revenge
menace: M A S H E E N
stages.coach: Sandy U-turns, and a bulldozer that loves U-turns. Keep moving.

stages.name: Vigor
stages.coach: Seven laps of pure vigour. Most of the field won't see lap three.

stages.name: The Gun Run
stages.coach: One lap at night, two guns, and backward ramps at the end. Pray the Radical gets held up.

stages.name: The Beach Arcade Dream
stages.coach: Halfpipes, sunshine and a monster. The doctor is in.

stages.name: Twisted Magic
stages.coach: Twisted roads under a magic sky. Watch the bends, not the stars.

stages.name: Dances with Monsters
boss: M A S H E E N
stages.coach: Loops, twists and two monsters. Everyone gets angry near the end.

tours.title: Beyond Madness
tours.blurb: The hardest stages ever built. Then the party.

stages.name: The Phantom's Lair
stages.coach: Six laps through the Phantom's home. Don't stop. Don't look back. Well, maybe once.

stages.name: Riot Coliseum
stages.coach: A riot in an arena, with the police joining in. Last car standing wins.

stages.name: Confusion In An Illusion
stages.coach: Sixteen checkpoints, hairpins everywhere. Get lost? That's the boss's name, not advice.

stages.name: The Hall without a Wall
stages.coach: No walls. Nothing between you and a very long fall.

stages.name: Survival of the Fittest
stages.coach: Only the fittest leave this one in one piece. Be the fittest.

stages.name: Ridin’ High
stages.coach: Thirty-one checkpoints up in the sky. Ride high, land soft.

stages.name: Space Walk
stages.coach: Low gravity, long jumps, no mercy. Find the road again after every jump.

stages.name: The Test of Endurance
stages.coach: One lap, eight checkpoints, and a very long way between them. Endure.

stages.name: Four Dimensional Vertigo
menace: M A S H E E N
stages.coach: A 4D object squashed into 3D, and the All Stars are racing. Follow the arrow. Good luck.

stages.name: The Mad Party
stages.coach: No fixing hoop. No mercy. Everyone's invited. It's the Mad Party!
